source:
@@U04417@@
I think of it even today.
Something wrong there, I'd say.
Something not right.

@@U04419@@
Can the Emperor have sinned
in giving him the seashore?
Didn't a herald proclaim it
throughout the land?
Well,
the first foothold
was planted not far from our dunes.
Tents and huts!
And before we knew it there was a palace
in the midst of green meadows and trees.

@@U04421@@
All day long workers toiled and slaved,
pick and shovel forever hacking away,
and all for nothing. But at night
we saw little flames swarming everywhere,
and the next day—
there stood the dam.
Men were sacrificed,
you could hear them at night
howling in their torment.
Floods of flame flowed seaward,
and at morning light we beheld a canal.
He’s a godless man.
He covets our cottage and our grove of lindens.
He boasts of being neighborly,
but expects us to be his slaves.

@@U04423@@
Yet he offered us a nice property
on the new-made land.
translation:
@@U04417@@
直到今天我仍然在想。
我想说，那里有问题。
有什么不对劲。

@@U04419@@
皇帝有罪吗
给他海滩？
不是有传令官宣布的吗
整个土地？
嗯，
第一个立足点
种植在离我们的沙丘不远的地方。
帐篷和小屋！
在我们意识到之前有一座宫殿
在绿色的草地和树木中间。

@@U04421@@
工人们终日辛苦劳作，
永远用镐和铲子砍伐，
而这一切都是徒劳的。但到了晚上
我们看到到处都是小火苗，
第二天——
大坝矗立在那里。
男人被牺牲了，
你晚上可以听到他们的声音
在他们的折磨中嚎叫。
火焰如洪水般涌向大海，
黎明时分，我们看到了一条运河。
他是一个无神论者。
他觊觎我们的小屋和椴树丛。
他自诩为人友善，
但期望我们成为他的奴隶。

@@U04423@@
但他为我们提供了一套不错的房产
在新造的土地上。
